photos.desc: Koeleria macrantha — Prairie Junegrass. Native bunchgrass in Grand Canyon National Park . The perennial habit is readily inferred by the old leaves lying around the base of the plant.
Junegrass (Koeleria macrantha syn. Koeleria nitida), Grass family (Poaceae). Small ridge along the road FR117 to the Chepeta Lake, Uintah, Utah; elevation 2500 m (8200 ft).
